b.x: This is attention training, not treatment. Panic that does not pass, open trauma, or a wish to die need people in the field. In Brazil, 188 if the wish is to die. 192 if the body has failed. This page does not dial.

An expanded mind without practice becomes a sentence. The practice is simple and has no audience. You choose a support that exists: the foot on the floor, the air coming in, the sound of the room. When the film starts — the argument, the fear, the sentence I cannot — you do not fight it. You give it a short name. Thought. And you return to the foot, or to the air. That is mindfulness. Notice, name, return. Each return is the training. It is not a failure. The failure is thinking the head had to stay empty. It does not. The craft is the return.

Once a day, at the start. Door closed, seated or standing. Eyes open, on a low point of the wall. It is not a trance. Feel the foot: heel, sole, toes. Let the air out more slowly than it came in, three times. Then stay. When the sentence arrives, say inside: thought. Return to the foot. If shame, fear, or the rehearsal of the day comes, the name is the same. Thought. One whole minute already serves. Three, if it fits. Do not score performance. Count only whether you returned. On the street, on the bus, in the queue, do not close your eyes. The support becomes the foot and the way out of the place. Mindfulness on the sidewalk looks like a man going to buy bread. It does not give you away. It is not flight. It is presence with the map of the room still on.
What it is for in the day

It serves the half second the other page spoke of. The trigger tightens, the belief is about to speak, and there is a gap. The practice widens that gap. You notice the shame before you obey the sentence I must not appear. You notice the fear before you live in it. You notice the anger before you answer. It does not erase the danger. On the street, two signs still mean leave. In the body, the stroke still means call. Mindfulness does not replace the gesture. It keeps the film from choosing the gesture for you. One minute in the morning. One return to the foot when the sentence arrives in the afternoon. That, repeated, is consciousness ceasing to be text.
